name: mgr-forge-creator
description: Plan and direct MGR-native 3D creation using existing Forge and MGR API/MCP, with source-rights, actual GLB and quality acceptance gates.

interface.longDescription: MGR 3D Forge creative workflow companion. Uses an already connected, authorized MGR Forge API/MCP or an approved local desktop workflow when available; this skills-only first release does not itself host a 3D generator, paid AI model or mobile-accessible server.
defaultPrompt: Create an original fantasy creature using MGR 3D Forge and show me real saved files and verification.
Audit what MGR Forge can build today and what is still missing.
Help me generate or revise a 3D world using the existing MGR Forge tools and receipts.
